title: India’s ‘eye in the sky’ Netra AEW&C system gets Final Operational Clearance
description: Indigenous system has already proved its worth during Balakot strikes and Operation Sindoor; scientists and IAF officers dedicate Netra clearance to colleagues killed in 1999 tragic air crash; ‘today, we have shown that their sacrifice has not gone in vain’, says DRDO Aeronautics Cluster chief
